github_installations_api.reason: The authenticated classic GitHub token cannot list user GitHub App installations.

mend_developer_portal.reason: The available in-app browser is not signed into GitHub; the requested Chrome browser family is not connected.

fallback_bootstrap.warning: The ephemeral Actions token cannot read GitHub Dependabot alert data. Adding security-events read did not change that result, so the ineffective permission was removed. Dependabot alerts remain enabled and were independently verified at zero open alerts with the authenticated maintainer API session.

recommended_resolution.option: Retain the manual-only bootstrap workflow as an auditable contingency and prefer the official hosted Renovate GitHub App for recurring operation once an authenticated owner browser is available.
recommended_resolution.rationale: The one-shot workflow proves configuration and update discovery without a persistent credential or schedule. The hosted App remains the cleaner recurring operating model.
verification: A Dependency Dashboard issue or Renovate-authored pull request exists.
The bot output resolves github>edithatogo/renovate-config without a configuration error.
Any update pull request passes repository CI and remains non-automerge.
recommended_resolution.fallback: Dispatch the pinned manual-only workflow for explicit update discovery; do not add a schedule or long-lived token without a separate governance decision.
recommended_resolution.stop_condition: Installing or changing GitHub App repository access requires an authenticated owner session and an explicit permission-grant action.
